subject: english-literature
title: Time-Twisting Tales
welcome_lead: Not every story moves forward. Some loop back to reveal the truth.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on chronology, flashback and structure.
final_note: You can now spot chronological and non-linear storytelling.

concepts.def: Events told out of time order.
Opening in the middle of action.
A story told inside another story.

walkthroughs.body_html: Chronological order moves forward in time. Non-linear order jumps around to surprise or reveal.
A flashback shows past events to explain present ones. Writers use it for backstory or twist.
In medias res (Latin: 'into the middle of things') opens at a high-action moment, hooking the reader fast.
